title: Confirm the whole v1 specification?
body: Confirming means the 21 documents above, with the four listed changes, are the v1 specification. I then push the branch fm/asmai-v1-spec and open a pull request to talvor/AssemblyAI, ready for review, for you to merge. If anything needs changing first, choose B and say what in the notes, or annotate the summary.
rec: A, if the four changes read right to you.
options: A: confirm the whole specification; push the branch and open the pull request
B: not yet: make the changes in my notes and annotations first
